title: The course
summary: The dungeon is built wave by wave from random 10-row blocks; each wave draws its blocks from its own pool.

sections.note: Blocks = how many blocks the wave lays down. Water and Gold are averages over the wave’s pool, weighted by how often each block is picked (Gold counts only gold that is sure to appear, scaled by its chance). The last wave repeats until the run ends.
